paras: Application: Nissan 370Z Z34 (2009-2020) and Nissan Z RZ34 (2023+) – RHD or LHD Part Type: In-tank fuel hanger surge tank (FHST) – fuel pumps not included Part Number: 20-1820

The Radium Fuel Hanger Surge Tank (FHST) is a surge tank built inside the OEM fuel tank, solving the fuel starvation that is common to the Z34 and RZ34 chassis during aggressive driving such as track use. It runs one or two aftermarket fuel pumps, supplies 1:1 regulated fuel to the engine, needs no sheet-metal modification and is E85 compatible.
hl: Drop-In Installation: Fits inside the OEM tank with no cutting or sheet-metal modification
1 or 2 Surge Pumps: Runs one or two aftermarket pumps
Pump Compatibility: Suits Walbro GSS342 (255 LPH) or AEM 50-1200 (E85) pumps
Integrated Regulator: Adjustable 1:1 fuel pressure regulator with swivelling vacuum port
Starvation Protection: Collector box fed by the OEM module pump, regulator return and 355 LPH one-way fill valves
Pressure Gauge: Fuel pressure gauge included
ft: Radium Engineering Fuel Hanger Surge Tank for Nissan 370Z & Z 400Z (Walbro/AEM, No Pumps)
